rationale: Sertraline (SSRI; moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor) to desvenlafaxine (SNRI; not primarily CYP2D6-metabolised). Sertraline's moderate CYP2D6 inhibition has minimal effect on desvenlafaxine levels (unlike venlafaxine, desvenlafaxine bypasses CYP2D6 metabolism to a large extent). Standard SSRI→SNRI cross-taper: start desvenlafaxine, overlap briefly, taper sertraline. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Continue sertraline 100 mg. Sertraline's moderate CYP2D6 inhibition has minimal effect on desvenlafaxine (largely non-CYP2D6 metabolised). Standard dose — no adjustment required.
Reduce sertraline to 50 mg. Continue desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Monitor for sertraline discontinuation symptoms.
Stop sertraline. Continue desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Titrate to 100 mg at 4 weeks if response inadequate.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Sertraline 100 mg → desvenlafaxine 50 mg (standard effective doses). Not pharmacologically equivalent. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
